metadata.name: MTA Bus Schedules: 2023
metadata.description: This dataset includes data for all bus schedules. It includes rows for each scheduled timepoint stop on a trip.

columns.name: Schedule Day
columns.description: Represents the date for the beginning of schedule trips, in a MM/DD/YYYY format.

columns.name: Day Type
columns.description: The day type for the schedule (Weekday, Saturday, Sunday).

columns.name: Borough
columns.description: Represents the five boroughs of New York City (Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, Staten Island).

columns.name: Operator
columns.description: Whether the bus route is operated by MTA Bus Company or NYCT.

columns.name: Service ID
columns.description: Name of service running for the day. The format of the codes varies between NYCT and MTA Bus routes. Both include the two-character depot code, the pick name, the last digit of the year, the type of day (Weekday/Saturday/Sunday), and if school is open, also SDon.

columns.name: Direction
columns.description: The N/S/E/W direction for the bus route. Many non-revenue trips have no defined direction.

columns.name: Shape ID
columns.description: The unique path for the bus trip. This consists of the bus route number followed by four digits.

columns.name: Trip Type
columns.description: The type of bus trip: 1 = Normal revenue trip;  2 = Pull-out from depot;  3 = Pull-in to depot;  4 = Deadhead;  10 = School service – Limited (School service is service on a variant path associated with a school.);  11 = School Service - Normal; 12 = Limited-stop service; 13 = Express service; 14 = Select Bus Service.

columns.name: Route ID
columns.description: The name of the route.

columns.name: Stop Sequence
columns.description: The order of stops for the particular bus trip.

columns.name: Stop ID
columns.description: The six-digit ID for each stop along the route.

columns.name: Stop Name
columns.description: The name of each stop, typically consisting of the two streets the stop is at the intersection of. This value is blank for non-revenue stops.

top.item: WHITE PLAINS RD/E GUN HILL RD

columns.name: Schedule Time
columns.description: The bus stop scheduled time, in a format of MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM.

columns.name: Origin
columns.description: Whether the stop is the origin (1) or the departure (0) terminal.

columns.name: Destination
columns.description: Whether the stop is the destination (1) or the arrival (0) terminal.

columns.name: School
columns.description: Whether the trip is made while school is open or closed. This value is blank for non-revenue and weekend and holiday trips.

columns.name: Revenue Stop
columns.description: Whether the stop is (1) or is not (0) a stop in revenue service.

columns.name: Timepoint
columns.description: Whether the stop is (1) or is not (0) used for timepoint measures. Field will always be 1 since this dataset only contains timepoint records.

columns.name: Boarding
columns.description: Whether the stop is (1) or is not (0) used for boarding.

columns.name: Alighting
columns.description: Whether the stop is (1) or is not (0) used for alighting.

columns.name: Distance from Start
columns.description: The distance from the start of the route, in feet.

columns.name: Trip Headsign
columns.description: The text shown on the bus route while in service.

columns.description: The identifier for a set of trips made a bus between when it pulls out of the depot and when it returns.
